name: CleverMyPage
author: Ambition4Clients

sections.description:
CleverMyPage is a WordPress plugin that extends the WooCommerce account page with functionality for managing customer data from CleverConnected. The plugin enables users to manage their personal data, subscriptions, orders, invoices, and newsletter preferences through their account page.

Key Features:

  • Manage Personal Data: Users can update their name, address, gender, email, and phone number
  • Manage Subscriptions: View and manage active subscriptions
  • View Orders: Overview of product orders
  • View Invoices: Download and view invoices
  • Manage Newsletter: Manage newsletter preferences
  • Address Change: Modify address information
  • Update Payment Method: Update payment methods
  • Request Redelivery: Request a new delivery
  • Cancel Subscription: Manage subscription cancellations

The plugin is fully configurable through the WordPress admin dashboard, where you can determine which functionalities are visible to users.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clevermypage folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the plugin settings page to configure the plugin
  4. Important: After saving settings, go to Settings -> Permalinks and click “Save Changes” to refresh the permalinks
  5. Configure the desired functionalities through the plugin settings

Requirements:

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce plugin (active)
  • PHP 7.0 or higher
  • CleverConnected API access (if applicable)
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to function as it uses the WooCommerce account pages.

Why do I need to save permalinks again?

The plugin adds new endpoints to the WooCommerce account page. By saving the permalinks again, these endpoints are correctly registered.

Can I disable certain functionalities?

Yes, through the plugin settings in the WordPress admin dashboard, you can determine which functionalities are visible to users.

Is this plugin compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

The plugin is developed to be compatible with standard WooCommerce functionality. Always test first in a staging environment when using with other extensions.

Which languages are supported?

The plugin includes Dutch translations and is prepared for multilingual support through the WordPress translation system.

2.0.22

  • Factuur-PDF: altijd via WordPress-proxy (geen directe link naar API). Rest_token ondersteund voor GET (invoice-pdf). Orders-pagina: Invoice-knop gebruikt nu proxy i.p.v. directe <a href>. Proxy stuurt Bearer-auth naar API.

2.0.21

  • Mijn gegevens: formulier en codebase gebruiken overal API-veldnamen (name, first_name, street, email, etc.). Postcode lookup request/response in API-vorm. Min-versie van cc_mp-public.js bijgewerkt.

2.0.20

  • API-fouten (401, 422, 500) worden nu in de toast getoond: auth-meldingen, validatiefouten (inclusief per-veld errors bij 422) en serverfouten.

2.0.19

  • Mijn gegevens: alle velden van het formulier worden nu meegestuurd naar het personal-data endpoint (naam, adres, e-mail, telefoon, mobiel). Formuliernamen (PREL_*) worden in de backend gemapt naar de API-velden.

2.0.18

  • 401-fix: fallback-authenticatie via kortlevende rest_token wanneer cookies niet meegestuurd worden (www/non-www, proxy)

2.0.17

  • Facturen: één PDF-knop (Download), Beschrijving uit order_type met fallbacks en normalisatie
  • Abonnementen: Type abonnement uit rate_type_description met fallbacks en normalisatie, Actief-knop rechts uitgelijnd
  • Menu: geen bullets meer op navbar-ul
  • Diverse template- en API-response-verbeteringen

2.0.16

  • Form save (personal data etc.): AJAX requests now send cookies explicitly (xhrFields withCredentials) to fix 401 when saving

2.0.15

  • Invoice PDF: download/view via plugin proxy with auth (no direct link without credentials)
  • REST URLs use current request host to fix cookie auth when site redirects www to non-www (or vice versa)
  • Invoices page: Bekijk PDF and Download PDF buttons; amount formatting (revenue_date, amount_incl, status)

2.0.14

  • Subscription and invoice euro formatting (€ 0,00 and € x,xx for numeric amounts)
  • Delivery complaint: show “- geen edities beschikbaar -” when no editions; Bezorgklacht only when print_editions = 1
  • Removed “Verhuizing doorgeven” button from subscriptions page

2.0.11

  • Fixed jQuery Migrate dependency: Added ensure_jquery_migrate() function to handle jQuery Migrate loading
  • Improved compatibility with WordPress 5.5+ where jQuery Migrate is not included by default
  • Added automatic fallback to CDN version of jQuery Migrate if WordPress doesn’t include it

2.0.10

  • Fixed jQuery noConflict compatibility: Wrapped all JavaScript code in jQuery noConflict-safe wrapper
  • Improved jQuery dependency handling: Ensured jQuery is always loaded before plugin scripts
  • Fixed potential conflicts with other plugins or themes that use jQuery

2.0.8

  • Fixed jQuery dependency: Added ensure_jquery() method to restore WordPress jQuery if theme deregisters it
  • Improved compatibility with themes that remove or deregister jQuery
  • Fixed translation file naming: Changed from CleverMyPage-.mo to clevermypage-.mo format
  • Added explicit load_plugin_textdomain() call for better translation support in WordPress plugin directory
  • Fixed payment method display: Now correctly extracts value from pipe-separated format
  • Fixed invoice status: Now calculated from invoice_balance (0 = Betaald, >0 = Te betalen)
  • Fixed invoice description: Now shows order_type from API
  • Fixed product-orders menu: Corrected newsletter menu item condition
  • Updated subscription mappings: Added support for new API fields (invoice_number, invoice_amount_incl, payment_link, etc.)
  • Removed “Veen Media” references from translation files

2.0.7

  • Fixed subscription field mappings: Added support for rate_type_description, invoice_amount_incl, payment_link
  • Added delivery date fields: last_shipped_delivery_date, next_edition_delivery_date
  • Fixed invoice status calculation based on invoice_balance
  • Updated payment method to use value from pipe-separated format

2.0.6

  • Security fix: Removed API key and API URL from JavaScript output
  • API key is now only used server-side and no longer exposed in HTML
  • All API calls continue to work via secure REST API endpoints

2.0.5

  • Fixed Bootstrap 5 navbar compatibility: Updated all templates from Bootstrap 3 to Bootstrap 5 syntax
  • Fixed menu visibility: Menu items now display correctly on desktop and mobile
  • Updated navbar classes: Changed from navbar-default to navbar-expand-lg navbar-light bg-light
  • Updated toggle button: Changed from data-toggle to data-bs-toggle for Bootstrap 5 compatibility

2.0.4

  • Fixed menu visibility issue: Changed boolean values from strings to integers for proper truthy checks
  • Fixed enabledOptions initialization to correctly display menu items when checkboxes are checked in backend

2.0.3

  • Fixed jQuery dependency: Changed from local jQuery to WordPress’ built-in jQuery
  • Fixed “Uncaught TypeError: $ is not a function” error
  • Updated script dependencies to use WordPress’ standard jQuery

2.0.2

  • Security improvements: All variables and options properly escaped when output
  • Fixed prefix naming: Replaced short “cc” prefix with “mypage” prefix (minimum 4 characters)
  • Updated option names: Changed from “_cc_options” to “_mypage_options” for better uniqueness
  • Removed external service dependencies: Replaced openiban.com API with client-side IBAN validation
  • Upgraded Bootstrap from 5.3.3 to 5.3.8 (latest stable version)
  • Added ABSPATH checks to prevent direct file access
  • Removed direct core file includes (wp-admin/includes/screen.php)
  • Improved error message escaping in REST API responses
  • Fixed URL escaping: Changed esc_attr() to esc_url_raw() for HTTP requests

2.0.1

  • Code cleanup: removed all debugging code and unnecessary comments
  • Improved code quality and readability
  • All PROOF-OF-CONCEPT and DEBUG functions removed
  • Cleaned up: commented code and unnecessary inline comments removed

2.0.0

  • First stable release for WordPress Plugin Directory
  • Full functionality for personal data management
  • Subscriptions, orders and invoices overview
  • Newsletter management
  • Configurable functionalities via admin dashboard
  • Dutch translations
  • Compatible with WordPress 6.6 and WooCommerce
